# `company.assembly_builds`

Immutable revisions of assembly builds: a finished assembly built from its components, pending or posted.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this immutable build revision. |
| `build_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with build_id + revision_number | — | — | Stable ULID of the build every revision of it shares. |
| `revision_number` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with build_id + revision_number | — | — | Revision of the build, from 1; the highest is current. |
| `status` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | pending (nothing posted, components reserved), built, voided or deleted. |
| `item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_assembly_builds_item | items.id | Inventory assembly item built. |
| `quantity_microunits` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Quantity of the assembly built, in micro-units. |
| `build_date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | ix_assembly_builds_item | — | Date the build is dated and valued on, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `memo` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Memo entered on the build; null when none. |
| `reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why this revision was written, as the caller gave it; null when none. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | ix_assembly_builds_transaction | transactions.id | Journal entry the build posted as; null while pending and for a pending build deleted. |
| `components` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | Canonical JSON of the bill of materials captured for this build: item, kind, quantity per assembly in base micro-units, and for a non-stock component its unit cost and account. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this revision was written. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that wrote this revision. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface this revision was written through. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this revision. |
